name: The Back Office Modernisation
owner: You, on behalf of your boss, who is accountable, and will say so if it goes well

events.text: The supplier's only engineer has gone on a sabbatical that the supplier describes as open-ended.
The new system was switched on by mistake, over a weekend, and some of it works. Nobody has been told which part.
The old system has been switched off a month early, to save money. Nobody has told the new one.
